name: Ollaya
description: Pulls and serves open decision models from a local daemon, Ollama-style, returning calibrated typed answers via a CLI, a TypeSafe-compatible HTTP API, or an MCP server.

skills.name: Pull and Run Models
skills.description: Pulls decision models by name and runs them with ollaya run, pull, list, ps, and related commands.

skills.name: TypeSafe-Compatible API
skills.description: Serves POST /v1/systemone, /v1/decisions, and GET /v1/models wire-identical to TypeSafe.

skills.name: Native Decide API
skills.description: Returns decisions with routing information and timings from /api/decide.

skills.name: MCP Server
skills.description: Serves the models to Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and other MCP clients via ollaya mcp.

skills.name: Modelfiles
skills.description: Bakes a question set into a custom model with ollaya create.
